entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to return something. My VeloBand tracker.
Certainly. I can help with that. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller. The order number is... um... VF884-26.

Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 26th. That was 13 days ago. To best help you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's... it's just broken, I think. The screen freezes up all the time. I'm not very good with these things and it's just not working right.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the screen. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. I can walk you through a quick reset procedure that usually clears that issue right up. Do you have the band with you?
Oh, I don't know. That sounds complicated. I **don't have time** for all that technical stuff. Can't you just help me? I thought I could just get a **refund**.

I understand you'd prefer a simple solution. Our process for a reported fault is to first try some basic troubleshooting. This helps us verify the defect, and often we can fix it right here on the call. It only takes about two minutes.
Two minutes or two hours, it's all so confusing. This whole thing is just **garbage**. Honestly, I don't want a replacement, I **just want money** back. This is all very overwhelming.

I hear your frustration, Sarah. For the VeloBand Pulse model, we have a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. Since you're at day 13, a return is only possible if we can verify a hardware defect. Without troubleshooting, I can't confirm the fault, and therefore I'm unable to process a **refund**.
Ten days? I didn't see that. The website was so confusing. So now I'm just stuck with a broken thing? Can't you just help me? This feels impossible.

I can absolutely still help you. My best option is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They are experts with the Pulse and can determine if it's a defect that qualifies for a warranty replacement. Would you like me to transfer you?
I... I guess so. I just thought this would be easier. It's all so much.
I understand. They'll take good care of you. Please hold one moment while I connect you to the technical department. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
